bearer.description: An access token from the identity provider (Keycloak).

info.description: Errors are application/problem+json with a stable code; see docs/api.md.
info.title: E-commerce Order System API

post.summary: Create a category, at most 4 levels deep

patch.summary: Rename a category or change its slug

post.summary: Move a category with its subtree; a null parent moves it to the top

get.summary: List products in any status, newest first, or by relevance with q
Read a product in any status, with its version as ETag

patch.summary: Change a product; needs If-Match with its ETag

post.summary: Make a product public; it needs an active variant
Hide a product; products are never deleted
Start an image upload: returns a pre-signed URL valid for 5 minutes

delete.summary: Remove an image; its object is deleted afterwards

post.summary: Confirm an upload once storage holds exactly the announced object
Add a variant naming one value of every option

patch.summary: Change a variant's price or status

post.summary: Create a coupon; its rule never changes afterwards

get.summary: Read a coupon with its usage

patch.summary: Switch a coupon on or off, move its end, or change its limit

get.summary: The category tree, sorted by name
Read the cart with current prices

post.summary: Create a guest cart; its token is in the response, this once

put.summary: Apply a coupon, replacing any other

delete.summary: Remove a line; removing a line that is not there changes nothing

put.summary: Set a line's quantity (1-10), adding the line if needed

post.summary: Quote the cart for a delivery state: prices, discount, GST and shipping, valid 10 minutes

get.summary: Read one of this cart's quotes
Read the profile; the first call creates it from the token

post.summary: Add an address (at most 10); the first becomes the default

delete.summary: Delete an address; deleting the default promotes the newest remaining one

put.summary: Replace an address; fields left out are removed

get.summary: Read the cart with current prices; empty at version 0 before the first item

put.summary: Apply a coupon, replacing any other

delete.summary: Remove a line; removing a line that is not there changes nothing

put.summary: Set a line's quantity (1-10), adding the line if needed

post.summary: Merge the guest cart named by Cart-Token into this cart, after signing in
Quote the cart for a delivery state: prices, discount, GST and shipping, valid 10 minutes

get.summary: Read one of the customer's quotes
Browse active products, newest first, or search them by relevance with q
An active product with its active variants and images
States and union territories with their GST state codes
